messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating catalog enable for `harbor-lite-7b` (canary 10% @ us-west-2). Change window 2026-03-25 02:00-04:00 UTC. rollout_id=cr-61789 :rocket:

sara-dev: Ack. I added the release note stub and linked the tracking doc. Are fallback priorities pre-seeded for this lite variant?

ben-infra: We have a default ladder but recommend soft-pin ordering for latency-sensitive customers: primary=harbor-lite-7b -> fallback1=harbor-7b-v2 (quant) -> fallback2=titan-compat -> fallback3=legacy-13b.

anya-sre: Suggest concrete rollback triggers: p50 latency > 350ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows OR error rate (5xx) > 1% sustained for 10m. Also enable fast-kill toggle on deploybot.

mike-ml: Adding quality guard: running SMOKE_REGRESSIONS eval every 15m. If ROUGE drops > 2.5 pts vs baseline for 3 runs, auto-degrade to fallback1 and open incident.

deploy-bot: Canary enable applied at 10%. Telemetry stream: /ops/catalog/harbor-lite-7b. To check status: `deploybot status cr-61789`

sara-dev: Confirming fallback map and soft-pin: primary=harbor-lite-7b, fallback1=harbor-7b-v2-quant, fallback2=titan-compat, fallback3=legacy-13b. Pinlist flagged to prevent auto-upgrades during window.

ben-infra: Heads-up: eu-west capacity low — routing may prefer fallback1 earlier. I'll add a region throttle: `region:eu-west -> max 5%` for the canary.

anya-sre: I'll wire SLA guards to infra: if 5xx > 0.5% over 10m then trigger immediate fallback and notify #incidents. Enabling trace sampling 100 spans/min for debugging.

mike-ml: Eval hook is live. If the eval monitor trips it will create a rollback ticket and ping @sara-dev and @anya-sre.

sara-dev: Observation plan: 2h at 10%, then expand to 30% if metrics stable. Manual holders for hold/release: @sara-dev, @ben-infra, @anya-sre.

ben-infra: Emergency rollback command (tested in staging):
```
deploybot rollback cr-61789 --to=harbor-7b-v2-quant --force
```
Can someone validate the command once more in prod dry-run?

deploy-bot: Dry-run executed successfully in prod staging. Will emit follow-ups when thresholds cross. :white_check_mark:

anya-sre: LGTM from SRE side. I'll stand watch for the first 90m and escalate if any anomaly.

sara-dev: :thumbsup: Observation window open. Updating release notes + docs: https://redwood.internal/releases/cr-61789. Will post a 1h checkpoint here.

ben-infra: Ping me if you want me to flip region drain earlier.

mike-ml: I'll post the first eval summary at +15m. Good luck folks.
